title: The session moves without anything being said: the user compacts it while it rests
expected: After the compaction the recap is still up to date: nothing was asked or done since it was written, so it is not shown as behind and nothing waits to be checked.

steps.user: Three small things: rename the 'Buy' button to 'Add to cart', make the price bold, and remove the old banner from the product page.

steps.agent: All three are done on the product page: the button says Add to cart, the price is bold, and the old banner is gone.

steps.compact: The user asked for three changes to the product page (button renamed to Add to cart, price bold, old banner removed). All three are done.

check.why: nothing was said since the recap was written, so it is not behind
nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
a compaction with nothing new to read costs no model request

steps.label: after the user opens it twice

check.why: opening the recap does not leave it marked as behind
opening a recap with nothing new to read costs no model request
